`real-turn-2026-09-18.jsonl` is the raw `claude --print --output-format stream-json` stream from one real turn on 2026-09-18 against `claude` 2.1.270 on Haiku (`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`), which cost $0.0138613 and proved the real ~70-variant proposal schema is accepted; every other fixture here is hand-derived from it by editing frames, so only that one is evidence.

`real-command-turn-2026-09-18.json` is the transcript the *app* stores — the same value `start_codex_conversation_edit_for_project` persists — from one real turn on 2026-09-18 that went through the app's own path with the stored `agentBackend` preference set to Claude and `claudeModel` set to Haiku. It cost $0.057903, the sidecar reported `video-creater: connected`, and the returned proposal validated into one `trimItems` action. It is evidence, not hand-derived, and `agent_claude::real_command_turn` replays it for free on every run.
